name: Rover (Aero)

tierList.prydwen: Support: T1 Tower of Adversity, T1.5 Whimpering Wastes

kit.intro: Free 5-star Aero Sword Support, mid-air combat focused, applying Aero Erosion via debuff conversion (removes other Negative Statuses and converts them 1:1 into Aero Erosion) and healing via Cloudburst Dance mid-air attacks and Ultimate. Currently restricted almost entirely to Cartethyia + Ciaccona teams.

skills.normalAttack: Basic Attack - Wind Cutter (4 hits), Aero.
skills.resonanceSkill: Awakening Gale - jump + Aero slash; Skyfall Severance in mid-air converts debuffs to Aero Erosion.
skills.forte: Cycle of Wind - governs Windstrings (max 120) -> Mid-air Attack: Cloudburst Dance (healing) -> Resonance Skill: Unbound Flow (enhanced, at max Windstrings) chain.
skills.liberation: Omega Storm - Aero AoE hit + team healing, castable mid-air (also used to instantly land after Forte attacks).
skills.intro: Relentless Squall - Aero strike, self +20% ATK for 10s.
skills.outro: Storm's Echo - grants +3 max Aero Erosion stacks to team for 30s (Cartethyia's key enabler).

bestWeapons: Bloodpact's Pledge (signature, free, 100% at R1 / 121.12% at R5 - only real option, gives Aero DMG Amplify + Energy Regen)
echoSet: Rejuvenating Glow (best generalist - 15% team ATK on heal)
substatPriority: Energy Regen (until satisfied - though signature weapon covers most of this)

teams.name: Best Team
teams.notes: Aero Rover's only genuinely strong team - tailored specifically for Cartethyia's Aero Erosion mechanics.

teams.name: Main DPS Iuno Team
teams.notes: Best buffer for Main DPS Iuno via signature weapon's Aero DMG Amplify.

rotation: Standard: Intro -> Forte: Cloudburst Dance P1,2 -> Ultimate -> Skill: Awakening Gale -> Cloudburst Dance P1,2 -> Skyfall Severance (optional) -> Mid-air plunge -> Forte: Unbound Flow P1 (swap) -> Outro (P2 auto off-field).
communityNotes: Prydwen: strong personal damage for a Support and free signature weapon, but functionally restricted to a single team (Cartethyia + Ciaccona) since no one else exploits her debuff-conversion mechanics; outclassed by Verina/Shorekeeper as a generalist Support due to lower overall buff strength, especially while capped at S1/R1.
